jobs.name: 窓の向こうの明日
jobs.description: 運転室から見渡す、夕暮れの港。
jobs.prompt: Use case: photorealistic-natural. Create ONE polished hero-background artwork for a Japanese crane-operator exam learning app, panoramic landscape approximately 2:1, ideally 2048x1024. Image only: no text, lettering, logos, watermark, phone frame, interface, collage or panels. Strong evocative composition, quiet professional dignity, nostalgia and hope rather than spectacle. Immediately recognisable crane machinery, credible steel structure, correctly connected boom/rails/ropes, no floating or duplicated components. No active lifting, no person beneath any suspended equipment. Important subjects in the right two-thirds and middle of frame; preserve a gently shaded uncluttered lower-left third for later WHITE Japanese UI copy, do not bake any copy into the artwork. Clean silhouettes still legible in a 358x180 phone hero. Generous crop-safe edges. Beautiful restrained color, no neon, apocalyptic smoke, fantasy machinery, lens flare covering subjects, or oversaturated orange. This is atmospheric promotional artwork, not a technical explanatory diagram. Scene and camera: an intimate first-person view from inside an unoccupied elevated harbor jib crane operator cabin, looking outward through a broad clear front window toward a tranquil Japanese harbor and far city at the end of the day. Camera at seated eye height, 28mm lens, horizon around the middle. Sparse dark cabin window frames at far top/right and a softly blurred modest plain console silhouette at the bottom edge only, not a detailed dashboard; no glowing UI or unreadable instrument text. One elegant dockside portal jib crane beyond the window at middle-right, its unloaded hook silhouetted against the peach band above the water, low mountain shore in the distance. The foreground interior is deeply navy, the harbor pale lavender and rose, a thin line of warm sunset lingering on the horizon with a few small harbor lights, reflections on calm water. Emotion: after the day's work, taking one quiet breath, looking ahead to tomorrow. Photographic realism, subtle fine film grain, believable glass reflections kept minimal, elegant cinema still, natural atmospheric depth. No person or hands visible. Do not make the cabin resemble an airplane cockpit or spaceship. The open harbor view dominates.
